style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust screens, warm light-grey #E7E3DD board for infographic screens, softly out-of-focus outdoor fields for carry scenes
style.iconSystem: thin-line circular icons, single stroke weight, outline only in #FFFFFF on scenes and #263A4E on light boards, one concept per icon
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light with a front-left key and soft fill, soft contact shadows; scene shots use natural daylight 5500K-6000K with consistent single direction; texture detail uses skimming side light
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent calm everyday-carry safety-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, warm light-grey board #E7E3DD, deep navy text #263A4E and one amber accent #C08442; neutral temperature, bright even high-key studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows, natural 5500K-6000K daylight direction kept consistent in carry scenes; modern geometric sans-serif only; thin-line single-stroke circular icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements whose label and value slots stay blank; compact upright product shown at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on angle with hands cropped below the shoulders and no face; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no weapon or threat styling.
noDrift: no numeric performance values or filled specification tables
style.presentationRules: compact upright product geometry kept consistent across screens, hands only and always cropped below the shoulders, mist shown as a fine even cloud into empty air
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm-grey board #E7E3DD, matte light-stone ledge #D8D2C9 and brushed split key rings, no glossy stage
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, deep navy text #263A4E, headline 32pt, subtitle 18pt, label 12-14pt, in-image copy only as blank slots and placeholders
